name: Copper Canyon Academy

siblings.name: New Leaf Academy of North Carolina

summary: Copper Canyon Academy was a program in Rimrock, Arizona, operated by Aspen Education Group. It operated from 1998 to 2014. The program was transferred to another operator.

value: NATSAP (former member; member from 1999, last listed 2012-13)
